liz_sales: Hey team — GreyFin procurement needs our assurance packet for legal review by EOD Friday. They specifically asked for SOC 2 Type II scope, ISO 27001 cert copy, and a signed pen-test confirmation. Can we assemble and confirm what we can share publicly vs. what needs an NDA?

sam_security: Got it. We can share the SOC 2 attestation PDF and ISO cert copy. Pen-test letter requires signed ROL (rules of engagement) — do they want the full report or just a letter of attestation?

liz_sales: They asked for a pen-test "letter" in the RFP. Assume attestation only unless they escalate. They're asking about data residency too — GreyFin wants confirmation that no customer data leaves EMEA for the private deployment option.

marta_engineering: For Private deployments we have the VPC/on-prem option. I can draft a short statement on data residency + KMS/HSM controls. Sam — will redacted pen-test excerpts be ok for them?

sam_security: Redacted excerpts should be fine for procurement but legal might request full report under NDA. Action: I'll prepare two artifacts — (1) signed pen-test attestation letter (no vuln details) and (2) redacted findings appendix for NDA. ETA: tomorrow morning.

ryan_sre: FYI the pen-test ROL lives in repo: `gitlab.com/redwood/compliance/pen-tests/2025-09-roller` — signing requires security lead + legal. I can sign off infra bits after security approves. Also prepping the SOC2 package to S3.

audits-bot: Evidence package created: s3://redwood-assurance/GreyFin/1712345678/package_v1.zip (access: restricted). Requestor: liz_sales (expires: 7d).

liz_sales: Thanks — can someone confirm which files are safe to upload to the customer portal (public link) vs require gated handoff? We want to avoid sending anything with raw IP or internal addresses.

sam_security: Public: SOC2 attestation PDF, ISO certificate, pen-test attestation letter. Gated/NDA: full pen-test report, redacted appendix if legal requests details, incident response runbooks, KMS key material (never shared).

marta_engineering: I'll draft the data residency + deployment controls blurb and drop into the package. Also including a one-paragraph on how our dedicated/private options keep logs in-customer-region.

liz_sales: Perfect. Can someone drop a short checklist I can attach to the procurement ticket? Procurement wants exact filenames and contact for signature.

sam_security: Checklist (to attach):
- SOC2_TypeII_Attestation_2025.pdf (public)
- ISO27001_Certificate_2024.pdf (public)
- PenTest_Attestation_GreyFin_2026.pdf (public)
- PenTest_Report_GreyFin_2026_redacted.pdf (NDA only)
- Data_Residency_Statement_GreyFin_2026.docx (public)
Contact for signatures: security@redwood-inference.com and legal@redwood-inference.com

ryan_sre: I'll update the S3 ACLs and create a temporary pre-signed link for the portal if needed. Post here when you're ready and I'll rotate creds.

liz_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll send the portal link to GreyFin after adding the checklist. If legal asks for the full report I'll coordinate NDA + signed ROL. :thumbsup:

audits-bot: Note: create-ticket assigned to @sam_security for signed pen-test attestation (due 2026-03-28).
